Subject: Sensory-friendly panel for Samir Khan — logistics and accommodations

Hi team,

Quick summary and asks for the panel on Tue, May 25 (10:00–13:00 PT):

- Candidate: Samir Khan — front-end engineering (applied accessibility experience).
- Panel structure: three 40-minute blocks (10:00, 11:00, 12:00) with 15-minute quiet breaks in between.
- Please plan to keep each block focused (2–3 core questions + 1 exploration).

Requests / logistics:
- We need a live captioner + auto-captions enabled on the Zoom. Access Solutions (cc'd) will provide a stenographer.
- Candidate comfort: Samir prefers a low-stimulation setup (no spotlighting, chat notifications off). He asked for a visual cue to indicate when a question has ended.
- Tech check: proposed 9:30–9:45 for the panel (short run-through + captioner check).
- Physical accommodation note: Samir may arrive on campus 20 minutes early and would like a quiet waiting room if he comes onsite.

Attachments: sensory-accom-form.pdf (filled by candidate), samir_khan_profile_redacted.pdf.

Please confirm availability and any conflicts. If you need the panel order adjusted, flag now — I want to send the calendar invite by EOD.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A few quick items from my side: 

- Confirmed: I can join tech check at 9:30.
- Please add a 5-minute visual countdown slide at the top of each block (simple green/yellow/red) for pacing — Aditya, can you use the screen-share slide when you open the block?
- Request to Scheduling: include a calendar note: "Do not Slack candidate during interview" and set notifications to mute for panelists.
- Could Access Solutions confirm whether they can provide an SRT file post-interview for the hiring packet? That helps with our debriefs.

Also attaching a short internal interviewer prep snippet below (internal-only):
- Start with brief intro (2 min).
- Use simple, single-part questions. Avoid compound prompts.
- If candidate signals overload (pauses, looks away), pause and offer a 30–60s break.

I can take the first block if order stands.

Irene Choi
Hiring Manager, Frontend Platform
